_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in when connecting Google / Microsoft. Neither is required for the local calendar to work.

google._setup: Google Cloud console -> enable Calendar API -> OAuth client of type 'TV and Limited Input device' (this box has no keyboard, so use the device-code flow).

microsoft._setup: Entra ID -> App registrations -> Authentication -> allow public client flows = Yes. Delegated permissions: Calendars.ReadWrite, offline_access. Use tenant 'consumers' for a personal @outlook.com account, or your tenant id for work.
